newsitem.title: MEXICO: Comercial Mexicana says April store sales rose.
newsitem.headline: Comercial Mexicana says April store sales rose.

text.p: Mexican retailer Controladora Comercial Mexicana said Wednesday that it recorded an April same store sales growth of 2.9 percent compared to April 1996.
Comercial Mexicana said the growth also compared to a sector wide decrease of four percent in April, as reported last week by the National Association of Supermarkets and Department Stores (ANTAD).

"Sales increased inspite the fact that Holy Week, which is traditionally a heavy sales period, was in March. For the first four months of 1997, the company reported same store sales growth of 2.2 percent.
